disruptions.summary: Disruption between Manchester Piccadilly and Rose Hill Marple / New Mills Central expected until the end of the day
disruptions.description:
A fault with the signalling system between Manchester Piccadilly and Rose Hill Marple / New Mills Central means that fewer trains are able to run. As a result, trains running between these stations may be cancelled out in full or revised to complete only part of the journey.

This is expected until the end of the day.

Customer advice:

You can travel on the next Northern service to your destination, where available.

Please note that other train operators may also be affected by disruption – please check your whole journey before travelling.

Northern train ticket restrictions have been lifted in the affected areas, including Advance and Peak restrictions, during this disruption. Restrictions will be reinstated once the disruption ends.

Check before you travel:

You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.

Compensation:

You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
